samples.listenFor: Instant dry grip and wood contact. Clearly distinct from the current UI click.
samples.prompt: Premium warm gothic Día de los Muertos noir. D minor, 100 BPM. Nylon guitar, damped brass bell, dry bone/wood, brushed frame drum, muted low brass. Isolated dry one-shot, immediate attack, clean short tail. No voice, coin rain, applause, EDM or screams. Tight paper grip and low wood contact; distinctive press feedback. Begin within 20 ms. Source 0.5 s, edited contact 0.10 s; silence after contact.
samples.sourceQuality: Provider MP3 preserved unchanged; 24-bit WAV is an edited decode, not a lossless-source claim.

mixRules: Preserve approved per-cue levels; one foreground voice; bounded overlapping tails.
Foreground cue ducks music 6 dB with 80 ms attack / 450 ms release.
No success sound on loss; no continuous coin shower.
Meter integrated program and true peak after edits; runtime combined master ≤−1 dBTP.
Phone and headphone audition required before approving the full 42 briefs.
Do not upload licensed stock recordings to generative services as reference material.
